answer:
The author of "Annabel Lee" is **Edgar Allan Poe**. He enlisted in the United States Army as a private on **May 26, 1827** (some sources state May 27), when he was 18 years old. 

To enlist, Poe used a false name ("Edgar A. Perry") and misrepresented his age to appear older than his actual age at the time. His military service lasted from 1827 until 1829.
